checks.text: With no tasks, the page shows the heading "Task List", the text "No tasks yet", and the progress bar "Progress" with `aria-valuenow="0"`.
Typing "Buy milk" in "New task" and pressing Enter adds one listitem containing "Buy milk" with the checkbox "Buy milk" not checked; progress stays "0".
After adding "Buy milk" and "Walk dog", checking "Buy milk" gives the text "Buy milk" `text-decoration-line: line-through` and progress "50".
Pressing Enter in the empty "New task" field adds no listitem and shows the text "Task text cannot be empty".

After adding "Buy milk", clicking "Edit Buy milk" shows the field "Edit Buy milk" with the value "Buy milk"; filling it with "Buy oat milk" and pressing Enter shows the checkbox "Buy oat milk" and no checkbox "Buy milk".

After adding "Buy milk" and "Walk dog", clicking "Delete Buy milk" leaves one listitem and shows "Task deleted"; clicking "Undo" makes the first listitem contain "Buy milk" again and the second "Walk dog".
After adding "Buy milk" and "Walk dog", focusing the checkbox "Walk dog" and pressing Alt+ArrowUp makes the first listitem contain "Walk dog" and the second "Buy milk".
Reload keeps the list: after adding "Buy milk" and "Walk dog" and reloading, the first listitem contains "Buy milk", the second "Walk dog", and progress is "0".
